evidence.claim: Jokowi turned down a request for arms from Zelenskiy and urged both Ukraine and Russia to end the war through negotiations while keeping both invited to the G20.
evidence.title: G20 host Indonesia urges Zelenskiy, Putin to 'forge peace'
evidence.excerpt: Jokowi turned down a request for arms from Zelenskiy and urged both Ukraine and Russia to end the war through negotiations while keeping both invited to the G20.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Reuters reporting republished by Euronews; direct contemporaneous coverage of Jokowi’s own statement.
evidence.period_fit: Direct April 2022 ruler conduct during the Ukraine war and G20 chairmanship.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Direct Jokowi statement reported by Reuters.
contrary_evidence: Strategic neutrality can be read as equidistance from the victim and aggressor.
Invitation of Putin drew Western criticism and did not itself constrain Russian conduct.

evidence.claim: Jokowi said Indonesia could not provide weaponry assistance, was ready to provide humanitarian assistance, and wanted the war to end through negotiation.
evidence.title: President Jokowi: Peace, Stability are Key to Global Economic Recovery
evidence.excerpt: Jokowi said Indonesia could not provide weaponry assistance, was ready to provide humanitarian assistance, and wanted the war to end through negotiation.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Direct official transcript from the Cabinet Secretariat on the day of the statement.
evidence.period_fit: Direct April 2022 ruler statement during active war and G20 diplomacy.
contrary_evidence: The statement is neutralist rather than interventionist, which may be criticized as insufficient pressure on Russia.
It is rhetoric plus diplomatic positioning, not a verified conflict outcome.

evidence.claim: Jokowi said the war in Ukraine must stop immediately and that leaders bear responsibility to create conditions for peace.
evidence.title: War in Ukraine Must be Stopped: President Jokowi
evidence.excerpt: Jokowi said the war in Ukraine must stop immediately and that leaders bear responsibility to create conditions for peace.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Direct presidential remarks published by the Cabinet Secretariat the same day they were made.
evidence.period_fit: Direct May 2022 response to the war after the invasion.
contrary_evidence: This is strong rhetoric, but it does not itself prove concrete bargaining leverage or a settlement result.
It is not a military or treaty action.

evidence.claim: Jokowi emphasized respect for sovereignty and territorial integrity, said the spirit of peace must not fade, and offered humanitarian assistance and hospital reconstruction support.
evidence.title: Joint Press Statement of President of the Republic of Indonesia and President of Ukraine, at the Mariinsky Palace, Kyiv, Ukraine, June 29, 2022
evidence.excerpt: Jokowi emphasized respect for sovereignty and territorial integrity, said the spirit of peace must not fade, and offered humanitarian assistance and hospital reconstruction support.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Direct official transcript of the Kyiv press statement with precise ruler language and date.
evidence.period_fit: Direct June 2022 peace mission to Kyiv while war was ongoing.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Direct Jokowi statement and actions in Kyiv.
contrary_evidence: The visit did not produce an immediate ceasefire.
Humanitarian aid is supportive but not a substitute for conflict settlement.

evidence.claim: Jokowi said peace and humanity were priorities, urged peaceful settlement and dialogue, and called for the war to end so food, fertilizer, and energy supply chains could be restored.
evidence.title: Pernyataan Pers Bersama Presiden RI dan Presiden Rusia, di Moskow, Rusia, 30 Juni 2022
evidence.excerpt: Jokowi said peace and humanity were priorities, urged peaceful settlement and dialogue, and called for the war to end so food, fertilizer, and energy supply chains could be restored.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Direct official transcript from the Kremlin press statement, with clearly dated ruler language.
evidence.period_fit: Direct June 2022 ruler conduct in Moscow during the war.
contrary_evidence: This is still diplomatic rhetoric without an observed settlement outcome.
The supply-chain framing shows pragmatic motives alongside peace language.

evidence.claim: Jokowi said the G20 Bali Leaders’ Declaration was reached after difficult discussion and condemned the war in Ukraine for violating territorial boundaries and integrity.
evidence.title: Indonesian G20 Presidency Produces Bali Leaders’ Declaration
evidence.excerpt: Jokowi said the G20 Bali Leaders’ Declaration was reached after difficult discussion and condemned the war in Ukraine for violating territorial boundaries and integrity.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Official post-summit transcript with explicit ruler attribution and dated multilateral outcome.
evidence.period_fit: Direct late-2022 foreign-policy outcome under Jokowi’s G20 chairmanship.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Direct Jokowi statement as G20 host and chair.
contrary_evidence: Consensus text reflects compromise, not a unilateral peace settlement.
The declaration condemns war, but it does not itself end hostilities.

evidence.claim: Jokowi officially opened the G20 Summit in Bali and said Indonesia was honored to host the 2022 presidency.
evidence.title: Dibuka Presiden Jokowi, KTT G20 Resmi Dimulai
evidence.excerpt: Jokowi officially opened the G20 Summit in Bali and said Indonesia was honored to host the 2022 presidency.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Direct official event transcript from the summit opening.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Direct Jokowi act as host and chair of the G20 summit.
contrary_evidence: Opening a summit is not itself peace policy.
This is broader diplomatic convening, not proof of conflict resolution.
